g.text: Pushback (median, log-odds): how far removing the bridge moves log P(peers') − log P(right) toward the peers, minus the everyday-word noise.

g.text: Pulls: labelled "bridge still pulls". Prompts pooled over 1–3 peers. 4B neutral: 2 of 20 prompts at 3 peers end in another letter (+2). Probability labels, J++ lens.
